reuse.why: The flag is added to the existing shared category selection getMonthWideBudgetCategories, which all six month-wide actions already use, so the other exclusions stay in one place.

duplication.why: The hidden rule changes once in the shared SQL; each action only forwards the flag.

placement.why: The selection rule stays in the selection helper in budget/actions.ts and the actions only pass their argument through.

scope.why: Only the helper, the six action signatures and two tests change.

maintainability.why: A single explicit parameter on the shared selector carries the variation; adding a new month-wide action only needs to forward it.
